replay_role: Historical prequential replay = initialization only, not performance evidence (spec 6)
implementation_notes_for_audit: sigma_M1 is computed and recorded for every FORECAST_READY opportunity, including rows whose distribution warmup is not yet met (M1_WARMUP_INSUFFICIENT); otherwise the Z_M1 pool could never start. This mirrors S0, whose pool uses sigma_M0 of every VOL-ready row.
v_long uses a running float sum of r^2 in date order divided by the count.
Class probabilities compare x_i = sigma_M1 * Z_i with +-0.25 * sigma_M0 in y-space (spec 4.2).
No predictive performance metric was computed.
